g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Azure Container Apps microservices with Front Door Private Link and KEDA scaling

g.title: None.None.Node.29
g.text: The shop's name resolves in Azure DNS to Front Door
Front Door, with its WAF policy, reaches the internal Container Apps environment over Private Link
The environment's ingress routes the request to the storefront app
The storefront reads the basket from Azure Managed Redis
and calls the payments app on its internal ingress
Payments records the attempt in Azure SQL
and authorises the card with the payment provider through the NAT gateway's fixed public IP
The storefront places the order with the orders app
Orders saves it to Cosmos DB
and queues a fulfilment message on Service Bus
KEDA scales the fulfilment app on the queue length; each replica takes a message
and marks the order shipped in Cosmos DB
A scheduled Container Apps job reconciles the day's payments every night
